recognize_zh: 這張圖並非成熟紅血球內的點狀體，而是一顆有核紅血球（核圓、染色質塊狀、胞質灰紫色）胞質內有數個小而圓、深紫色的核碎片，即有核紅血球中的Howell-Jolly小體樣包涵體。
features: Single nucleated cell with round central-to-eccentric nucleus and coarsely clumped (checkerboard) chromatin
Several small, round, dense dark purple cytoplasmic inclusions adjacent to the nucleus, resembling Howell-Jolly bodies
Scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles and irregular cell border
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at very high magnification shows a single nucleated cell with a round nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, and gray-lilac polychromatophilic cytoplasm, most consistent with a polychromatic normoblast. The cytoplasm contains several small, round, dense dark purple inclusions adjacent to the nucleus, resembling Howell-Jolly bodies (nuclear fragments), along with small vacuoles. Classic Howell-Jolly bodies in mature anucleate red cells are not shown in this field. Findings are suggestive of Howell-Jolly body-like nuclear fragments in a nucleated red cell, as seen with dyserythropoiesis, megaloblastic change, or hyposplenism.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are smaller, multiple, irregular granules clustered at the periphery and are Prussian blue positive.
Plasma cells have a markedly eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear hof and deep blue rather than gray-lilac cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed nuclear debris in a monocyte/macrophage
ddx.vs: Phagocytes have larger size, folded nuclei, and debris within vacuoles rather than free round fragments.
